summary: Connect a synthetic order list to rack locations and explicit pick confirmations.
objective: Build a warehouse pick tour with numbered rack bays and a cart that stops for each order item.
example_prompts: Build a warehouse pick tour with numbered rack bays and a cart that stops for each order item.
Let me compare the planned stop list with confirmed picks.

entities.name: Racks
entities.guidance: Create uprights, cross beams, shelf decks and readable bay/level signs.

entities.name: Cart and totes
entities.guidance: Give cart chassis, wheels, handle and separate tote slots with item labels.

entities.name: Aisles
entities.guidance: Mark walkable centerlines and turning areas away from rack envelopes.

object_craft.structure: Create uprights, cross beams, shelf decks and readable bay/level signs.
object_craft.material: Painted steel-looking uprights and neutral shelf decks.

object_craft.structure: Give cart chassis, wheels, handle and separate tote slots with item labels.
object_craft.material: Polymer totes and brushed frame; wheel detail remains subordinate to route.

object_craft.structure: Mark walkable centerlines and turning areas away from rack envelopes.
object_craft.material: Low-contrast concrete floor with restrained route markings.

state_contract.model: Authored inventory by SKU and bay, requested quantities, confirmed pick log, cart path and stop index; this is a synthetic order exercise.
state_contract.authority: Domain state owns identities, values and accepted transitions. Derive labels and meshes from that state; camera and display offsets are separate.
actions: Confirm quantity only while stopped at its bay.
Undo a pick and reset inventory.

invariants: Inventory cannot become negative and picked quantities cannot exceed the requested remainder.
A confirmation updates shelf quantity and tote quantity atomically.
Route playback alone never confirms a pick.
motion_guidance: Cart follows a collision-clear aisle path with bounded speed and turn rate.
Stop at bay before activating pick controls; derive wheel angle from distance when shown.
known_limits: No route optimality, worker productivity or real inventory accuracy is claimed.
Authored recipe only; runtime and rendered geometry checks have not run.
creative_affordances: Rack signage and tote labels expose operational identity without overwhelming the scene.

physical_contract.scope: Constrained cart tour with discrete inventory actions.
colliders: Cart box envelope and rack/aisle bounds.
driving: Authored route with acceleration and turn limits.
contact: Stop before blocked aisle; cart stays supported on flat ground.
physical_contract.timestep: Use a declared fixed update step for changing model state; interpolate presentation only. Pause clears accumulated playback time.
checks: Reject pick at wrong bay; blocked path cannot penetrate racks.
